div.head: I Cn 11
div.ab: Gyf hwa þonne þegna sig, þe on his boclande cyrican hæbbe, þe legerstow on sig, gesylle þone þriddan dæl his agenre teoþunge into his cyrican.
Gif hwa þonne þegen sy, þe on his boclande cyricean habbe, þe legerstow on sy, gesylle þonne þriddan dæl his ágene teoþunge into his cyrican.
Si quis tainus in hereditate sua terram habeat, in qua cimiterium sit, det ibi tertiam partem proprię decimę suę.
Gyf hwa þonne þegna sig þe on his boclande cyrican hæbbe þe legerstow on sig, gesylle þone þriddan dæl his agenre teoþunge into his cyrican.
If, however, there is any thegn who, on the land which he holds by title deed, has a church to which a graveyard is attached, he shall give the third part of his own tithes to his church.

Wenn [es] aber einer der Adligen ist, der auf seinem kraft Urkunden[privilegs besessenen] Lande eine Kirche hat, an der ein Friedhof liegt, so zahle er ein Drittel des auf ihm [lastenden] Zehnten an diese seine Kirche.
If, however, it is one of the thegns who has on his bookland a church at which there is a graveyard, let him pay a third of the tithe [owed] by him to [this] his church.
div.note: Quadr. writes ‘terram’ but means ‘ecclesiam’. Liebermann compares II Eg 2.
